title: Brothers died young; played music by force
summary: Eddie lists his brothers' ages at death and says music did not shorten his life. He played by force, never loved it, unlike Lawrence and his father.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: All my brothers died young. Solomon 41. John 44. Lloyd 59. Going up there. He wasn't quite 59. Yeah. I'm going on 7-8.
But you didn't stop playing music to prolong your life. Oh, music won't kill me. You didn't know how long you used to live.
You didn't play music because you didn't like it.
You didn't like it from the beginning. No, I didn't like it. You only started because Lawrence partly persuaded you.
You know, how I played music by force. Yeah. I didn't want both.
At no time. I wasn't crazy about it. Mm-hmm. Now you understand? Yeah. I played before. That's right. Well, Lawrence and them loved it. Mm-hmm.
They took after my dad. I didn't.
He didn't like music. He didn't even like to dance.

My dad would play all his life music. Mm-hmm. And then three better than my dad does. I didn't. I got away. That's right. Mm-hmm. Now, you know. That's what you want to know. That's what I'm trying to tell you.
There's no disgrace to say you don't like something. Everybody. You need your song.
That's what I'm trying to tell you.
